title: DVR existence closes an immersion in a proper domination diagram
statement: Let $X,Y,P,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $f:X\to S$, $\pi:Y\to X$, $i:Y\to P$, and $q:P\to S$ be morphisms such that $qi=f\pi$. Assume $\pi$ is proper and $q$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], $i$ is an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], $Y$ is quasi-compact (every open cover of its underlying space has a finite subcover), and $P$ is Noetherian, meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact. Assume also the following existence condition on $f$: for every discrete valuation ring $A$ [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] with fraction field $K$, and every pair $a:\operatorname{Spec}K\to X$, $b:\operatorname{Spec}A\to S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with $fa=bj$, where $j:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ comes from $A\hookrightarrow K$, there exists $h:\operatorname{Spec}A\to X$ with $fh=b$ and $hj=a$. Then $i$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. No surjectivity of $\pi$, separatedness of $f$, or uniqueness of its DVR lifts is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0208 (lemma-Noetherian-dvr-valuative-proper), equation-solid and final contradiction, extracted for an arbitrary Noetherian separated ambient scheme in place of projective space.

proof.text: $P$ is locally Noetherian by hypothesis, hence quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated]. Since $Y$ is quasi-compact, [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1) makes $i$ quasi-compact. An immersion is locally of finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-immersion-base-change-lft](2). Thus $i$ is of finite type by [def-weil-finite-type-morphism].

source.place: Tag 01T5, lemma-immersion-locally-finite-type; properties.tex Tag 01OY, lemma-locally-Noetherian-quasi-separated; schemes.tex Tag 03GI, lemma-quasi-compact-permanence.

proof.text: Suppose the image $E=i(|Y|)$ is not closed and choose $p\in\overline E\setminus E$. Apply [lem-sfb-noetherian-image-boundary-dvr] to the finite-type map $i$ with locally Noetherian target $P$. Obtain a DVR $A$, fraction field $K$, maps $u:\operatorname{Spec}K\to Y$, $v:\operatorname{Spec}A\to P$, and $j:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, with $iu=vj$ and $v(s_A)=p$.

source.place: Tag 0208 (lemma-Noetherian-dvr-valuative-proper), equation-solid and final contradiction; arbitrary separated ambient P.

proof.text: Put $a=\pi u$ and $b=qv$. The given compatibility yields $fa=f\pi u=qiu=qvj=bj$. The assumed existence condition on $f$ gives $h:\operatorname{Spec}A\to X$ with $fh=b$ and $hj=a=\pi u$. Thus $(u,h)$ is a commuting valuative square for $\pi$.

source.place: Tag 0208 (lemma-Noetherian-dvr-valuative-proper), equation-solid and final contradiction; arbitrary separated ambient P.

proof.text: A DVR is a valuation ring by [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring]. Apply [lemma-nagata-proper-valuative-criterion-existence-api] to the proper map $\pi$ and the square $(u,h)$. Obtain $w:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ with $\pi w=h$ and $wj=u$. In particular $qiw=f\pi w=fh=b=qv$.

source.place: Tag 0208 (lemma-Noetherian-dvr-valuative-proper), equation-solid and final contradiction; arbitrary separated ambient P.

proof.text: The maps $iw,v:\operatorname{Spec}A\to P$ are over the same map $b$ to $S$, and their generic restrictions agree: $iwj=iu=vj$. Apply [lemma-nagata-separated-valuation-lift-unique] to the separated map $q$ to obtain $iw=v$. At the closed point this gives $p=v(s_A)=i(w(s_A))\in E$, contrary to the choice of $p$.

source.place: Tag 0208 (lemma-Noetherian-dvr-valuative-proper), equation-solid and final contradiction; arbitrary separated ambient P.

proof.text: Therefore $i(|Y|)$ is closed in $P$. Since $i$ is an immersion, [lem-weil-pbc-immersion-closed-image-closed-immersion] implies that $i$ is a closed immersion.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q14-38e686748 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read Stacks limits.tex Tag 0208 (lemma-Noetherian-dvr-valuative-proper, lines 3927-4006) in full. The item takes out the core of the (4)=>(1) contradiction, with i:Y->P in place of X'->P^n_S, pi in place of X'->X and q in place of P^n_S->S. Birationality and surjectivity are not needed because existence is assumed for all DVR squares, and the uniqueness for the ambient map comes only from q being separated. There are 0 new nodes, the statement and stmt_deps are unchanged, and there is no re-split note. Every cited statement was opened. Step 1: locally-Noetherian implies quasi-separated (Mathlib leaf); qcqs-permanence (1) applies with Y quasi-compact and P quasi-separated; immersion-lft (2) and the finite-type definition give that i is of finite type. Step 2: lem-sfb-noetherian-image-boundary-dvr (same unit, its deps do not include the item, so no cycle) has exactly these hypotheses and gives A, K, u, v with iu=vj and v(s_A)=p. Step 3 is truly elementary and uses the item's own existence hypothesis. Step 4: the DVR definition records that a DVR is a valuation ring; proper-existence-api (Lean-closed via UniversallyClosed.eq_valuativeCriterion, and its blueprint_update is still fine for proper maps) gives w with pi w=h and wj=u. Step 5: separated-lift-unique (Lean-closed via IsSeparated.valuativeCriterion) applies to q, iw and v over b, so iw=v and p lies in the image, a contradiction. Step 6: an immersion with closed image is a closed immersion (Mathlib leaf). proof_deps equals the union of the uses; no SGA is cited. Edge cases checked: Y empty, i already a closed immersion, and the inclusion of G_m in A^1, which does not satisfy the existence hypothesis. No changes.
